steps.label: USER namespace
steps.sub: container "root" can map to an unprivileged host user

code:
$ docker run -it ubuntu bash
root@3f2a9c1d4e5b:/# ps aux
USER   PID  %CPU  COMMAND
root     1   0.0  bash
root    12   0.0  ps aux

# Only this container's own processes are visible
caption: The container believes it has its own machine -- one more process on the host's single kernel.

eyebrow: cgroups: how much a container can use
code:
# Limit a container to 512 MB of memory and half a CPU core
docker run -d \
  --memory="512m" \
  --cpus="0.5" \
  northbridge/catalog:latest
caption: Without cgroup limits, one runaway container could starve every other container on the host.
